title: J1 Back-normal S1 pancake + side-hung S2

extra.summary: S1' (AK70) lies flat on a planar back-plane pad, axis along +x; a 12 mm yoke bar swings the S2 AK70 (axis in the back plane) round it; the S2 motor sits beside the S1 disc, the arm leaves its flange. Depth 111.5 mm behind the back (baseline 181) but the S2 axis is offset 106 mm from the S1' axis and S1' now carries gravity.

S2.dir: s = (0, cos th1, sin th1) (in the back plane, turns with S1')
S2.at: crosses the S1' axis at x=-45.0; arm axis crosses it 105.8 mm along s

extra.kinematics: d = (-sin phi, -sin th1 cos phi, cos th1 cos phi); park-equivalent th1=-18.2 phi=17.4 (baseline S1 45/S2 25)
extra.uncovered_note: near-forward directions (phi near 88) sit at a gimbal singularity of S1' (arm along -x): coverage is geometric; the controller cannot hold th1 there

P.arm_base_wander: arm base moves on a circle of radius 105.8 mm about the S1' axis as th1 changes (non-concurrent S1'/S3)

torque.inputs: arm beyond S2 1.489 kg CG 0.249 m; payload 0.5 kg at 0.575 m; S2 AK70 0.621 kg at t=72.6 mm; yoke 0.15 kg; g=9.81
torque.baseline_reference: baseline S1 carries no gravity (vertical axis); S2 6.49 unbalanced / 2.89 balanced (SF 2.87)
torque.transmission: direct drive (no gearing), no added backlash

extra.stops: S1': two PETG-CF posts at +-r54 on the pad at the hard limits (soft +-5 deg), lug on the yoke disc; TPU 95A caps as baseline. S2: two pad posts on the clamp ring at the hard limits, lug on the adapter. Passive, 5 deg margin kept.
extra.balancer: S2: zero-length spring anchored on the yoke (rotates with S1') torque K sin(phi); S1': zero-length spring base-to-yoke with a phase offset (needs a second balancer, packaged in the 6 mm gap behind the yoke bar / on the pad rim). PLACEHOLDER vendor springs.
extra.wiring: no hollow shaft assumed (AK70 solid output: PLACEHOLDER, verify): 8.2 mm bundle runs in a flat clockspring/service loop in the 12 mm yoke gap, then along the yoke bar to the S2 motor and through the S3 bracket; S1' range 130 deg fits a single flat-flex loop.
conflicts: Forest override: shoulder no longer ball-styled and axes not concurrent (S1'-S2 concurrent at x=-45.0; S3 offset 105.8 mm). Everything else kept.
S1' now carries a gravity moment (baseline S1 had none); 5-deg rule kept
extra.contract_changes: chassis plate + S1 base block + pauldron keel/crown retired; the new base pad (R62 x 6) bolts to a riser from the wing tongue (not modelled; pad front face -107.3 mm = 22 mm off the skin max over the pad, S2 sweep needs +34.4 mm).
pros: depth 111.5 mm behind the back vs 181 (-38 %)
no S1 vertical base block (80 mm deep) and no big cowl
cons: S1' needs a gravity balancer (SF 1.20 unbalanced) in addition to S2
arm base offset 106 mm from the S1' axis wanders on a circle: keep-out tables, homology map, head clearance all change
S2 motor sweeps a large disc over the back (needs 20 mm over the blade: sets pad height)
risks: head/neck proximity of the swept S2 motor (see head_neck_min_distance)
no hollow shaft: cable loop life
S1' balancer must be re-sized if payload changes
gates_to_rerun: control_map homology (S1' axis x, offset base)
harness_loads (mass moves 100 mm closer, new moment arm)
assumptions: F1/F4 seats and wing are generic proxies
pad y1,z1 chosen by hand (-70,-35), not optimised
torque study uses the project mass numbers, payload 0.5 kg at 575 mm
